SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'database',current_database(),'session_user',session_user,'current_user',current_user,
 'serverVersionNum',current_setting('server_version_num')::integer,
 'serverVersion',current_setting('server_version'),
 'serverEncoding',current_setting('server_encoding'),'clientEncoding',current_setting('client_encoding'),
 'bootstrapRows',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'bootstrapOid',oid::text,'bootstrapName',rolname,

 rolreplication,rolbypassrls,rolconnlimit,rolvaliduntil,rolconfig)) ORDER BY oid),'[]'::jsonb)
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE oid=10));

productionBootstrapProvenanceSchema.attributeRole: OID/name establish bootstrap identity. All eleven attributes are additional fidelity inputs and must match expected catalog and final destination; privilege flags alone are not identity evidence.
productionBootstrapProvenanceSchema.beforeAfterRule: Complete query response identity, bootstrap tuple and encodings equal; both match expected catalog bootstrap row. Existing whole-catalog pre/post checks remain. Bind actual role output bytes to roles proof outputSha256, capture timestamps, invocation, sidecar, manifest files.roles.sql.
productionBootstrapProvenanceSchema.canonicalResultSha256: SHA256(canonical {before: PRE canonical response, after: POST canonical response}); each measurement also has its own canonicalResponseSha256. Timestamps/phase/proof references are not included in the semantic PRE==POST comparison.
productionBootstrapProvenanceSchema.captureId: Equal manifest.backupAttempt; not a second independent lifecycle id.
productionBootstrapProvenanceSchema.chronology: PRE measurement ends <= roles dispatch starts <= roles completed <= POST measurement starts. TLS session proof attests the same live process/target at handshake, not a requirement that measurement fall before proof.completedAt; retain measurement timestamps and live-session proof reference separately.
productionBootstrapProvenanceSchema.consistencyLimit: Global roles capture is non-MVCC. Before/after agreement detects observed drift but does not prove atomic cross-client global snapshot or eliminate an ABA change. Keep existing SEPARATE_NON_MVCC_CAPTURE_BEFORE_AFTER_FINGERPRINT_MATCH classification and provider-hop risk; production adoption must explicitly accept this finite consistency model.
identityMustProve: exactly one actual pg_roles oid=10 row
raw OID int10 or canonical string10 only; bool/float/whitespace variants rejected; retain raw value/type and normalized10
actual role name nonempty, ASCII profile <=63 bytes, source roles tuple correspondence
productionBootstrapProvenanceSchema.placement: Within capture_backup: PRE in existing exporter READ ONLY session immediately before pg_dumpall dispatch, POST in existing fresh afterObservation READ ONLY session after roles completion; do not create a third production session.
productionBootstrapProvenanceSchema.privacy: Closed typed schema, private immutable file. No passwords/DSN/credential bytes/raw authorization nonce. Role configs and removed statement stay private; public diagnostics contain safe codes/hashes only. Exact private serialization uses existing exclusive(..., redact=False) only after closed-schema validation; generic sanitizer must not alter fidelity-bearing bytes.
productionBootstrapProvenanceSchema.rawResponsePolicy: Current _Session._exchange strips protocol framing/line endings. rawResponseAvailable=false, rawResponseSha256=null. Do not call re-encoded returned text raw stdout. Strict JSON and canonical response retain actual returned typed values.
productionBootstrapProvenanceSchema.sourceQuery:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'database',current_database(),'session_user',session_user,'current_user',current_user,
 'serverVersionNum',current_setting('server_version_num')::integer,
 'serverVersion',current_setting('server_version'),
 'serverEncoding',current_setting('server_encoding'),'clientEncoding',current_setting('client_encoding'),
 'bootstrapRows',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'bootstrapOid',oid::text,'bootstrapName',rolname,
 'roleTuple',jsonb_build_array(rolname,rolsuper,rolinherit,rolcreaterole,rolcreatedb,rolcanlogin,
 rolreplication,rolbypassrls,rolconnlimit,rolvaliduntil,rolconfig)) ORDER BY oid),'[]'::jsonb)
 FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles WHERE oid=10));
